    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.123.1...0.124.0">0.124.0</a> (2026-10-06)</h2>
<h3>⚠ BREAKING CHANGES</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> remove hosted ChatKit provider (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11434" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11434/hovercard">#11434</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> make WatsonX SDKs opt-in (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11359" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11359/hovercard">#11359</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> make Langfuse SDK opt-in (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11351" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11351/hovercard">#11351</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> make Slack SDK opt-in (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11349" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11349/hovercard">#11349</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> make OpenAI Agents an explicit install (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11177" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11177/hovercard">#11177</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> make Codex Security SDK opt-in (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11325" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11325/hovercard">#11325</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> make browser SDKs explicit installs (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11163" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11163/hovercard">#11163</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> make local Transformers opt-in (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11119" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11119/hovercard">#11119</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>cli:</strong> support comma-separated OR values in --filter-metadata (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11320" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11320/hovercard">#11320</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/b7cae9ff5b756fdca72af54e0d3dcc25d5238d4c">b7cae9f</a>)</li>
